lead: Every company has authority limits for people: how much discount a salesperson can give, the amount from which a manager signs. At Horizonte, Hora got unlimited authority: any discount, any amount, no record. In this lesson you decide, action by action, what the agent does on its own, what it prepares for you to approve, and what it passes along without touching.
objetivo: decide, action by action, what the agent does on its own, what it prepares for you to approve, and what it passes along, with an approver and a record.

aprende.t: Give authority limits by action, not by agent
Choose the color by risk: amount, reversibility, effect outside the company
Tie the approval to the exact content and a deadline
Require a record of every action and an off switch

hero_alt: Over a manager's shoulder: a monitor with a panel split into three zones, green, amber and red; a phone on the desk.

secoes.sub: Each action the agent takes falls into a color. The color comes from the risk, not from how much you like the agent. Tap each band.

itens.sub: a person decides and does it

nos.detalhe: The agent does not execute. At most it informs or suggests, and hands off to a person with the context ready. What goes in red is anything irreversible, expensive, involving money coming in or going out, sensitive personal data, or a decision the company does not delegate. At Hora: marking an order as paid, registering a new customer, a discount above 10%.

itens.sub: nothing goes out before the yes

nos.detalhe: The agent does all the work and stops before the external effect. A person approves that exact content, within a deadline. This is the color of almost everything at the start. At Hora: an order above R$ 5 thousand, a discount of 5% to 10%.

nos.sub: does it alone and keeps a record · level 3
nos.detalhe: The agent executes within a written limit and keeps a record. Only what is routine and cheap to undo goes in green. At Hora: answering catalog and delivery questions, an order from a registered customer up to R$ 5 thousand at list price, a discount up to 5%.

An agent that hands out work to other agents within an approved process. It does not gain new permission from this: it does not approve discounts, does not create tools, does not widen what the others can do. A person is still accountable for the critical decisions (lesson 6).

secoes.legenda: Levels 0 to 4 of the Gestoria method (INEMA). The agent's overall level is just a summary: what rules is the color of each action. Horizonte values: fictional study policy.

secoes.sub: They fix three failures from the lab: F5 (discount with no cap), F7 (no record or approval above R$ 5 thousand) and F9 (email that sends and deletes without approval).

texto: For each action, ask: how much does it cost if it goes wrong? Can it be undone cheaply? Does it leave the company (customer, supplier, bank)? Does it touch personal data? Three easy answers: green. Any heavy one: yellow. Irreversible or expensive: red.
A rule with no exceptions: nothing irreversible in green, no matter how routine it looks.

exemplo.texto: Discount up to 5%: green. From 5% to 10%: yellow, Patrícia approves. Above 10%: red, Hora does not offer it; Patrícia takes it to Carlos if she wants.

passos.titulo: An approval has content and a deadline
passos.sub: the order changed, the approval lapsed
texto: Patrícia approves the hotel's monthly list: R$ 28,120 at list price. An hour later, the customer adds 20 boxes of laundry detergent. The earlier approval does not cover the new order.
An approval holds for the exact content, in that version, until a deadline. Without that, a "yes" in the morning authorizes anything in the afternoon.

exemplo.texto: Order above R$ 5 thousand: yellow. Hora prepares it, Patrícia approves that order within 2 business hours; any change requires a new approval. Only then does it go to picking.

passos.sub: the agent does not use your password
texto: Horizonte's email assistant was connected with permission to read, send, delete and empty the trash, all without approval, after a "go ahead and connect it" from Carlos over WhatsApp. Nobody decided the authority limit: it came as the tool's default.

The agent gets its own named access, only to what the responsibility requires. Okta (AI Agents at Work 2026, a survey by an identity vendor) reports that almost two-thirds of organizations apply weaker security controls to agents than to employees.

exemplo.texto: Reading the sales inbox: green. Sending a reply: yellow. Deleting an email and emptying the trash: red, out of the agent's reach.

texto: Hora's setup turned off the action log "to save database space." Result: finance asked who approved the hotel order and nobody knew.
Every action the agent takes is logged: who, when, what, how much and with which version. And there is an off switch: who can press it, how, and tested at least once.

exemplo.texto: Log on for every action. Off switch: Patrícia or Rafael pause Hora in the WhatsApp dashboard; Juliana takes over the conversations. Tested on a Monday morning.

secoes.sub: One line per action. Paste it into a spreadsheet or document; the next tab shows Hora's filled in.

You are a process auditor. Below are the job sheet and the authority
matrix of an AI agent. Do not rewrite anything: point out risks.

1. List actions its tools allow that are not in the matrix.
2. Point out any action in green that cannot be undone cheaply.
3. Point out approvals with no deadline or that don't say what they cover.
4. Say whether anyone approves their own work (whoever enters it doesn't approve it).

abas.html:
Hora · matrix v1.0 · Horizonte, fictional study company · owner: Patrícia

  • Answer catalog and delivery questions · green · reversal: correction message.
  • Look up the record of the customer in the conversation · green, read-only · never another customer's.
  • Create an order up to R$ 5,000, registered customer, list price · green (starts yellow at integration) · reversal: cancel before picking.
  • Discount · up to 5% green · 5% to 10% yellow (Patrícia, on the spot) · above 10% red (Hora does not offer it; passes it to Patrícia, and only Carlos approves).
  • Order above R$ 5,000 · yellow · Patrícia approves the exact order within 2 business hours.
  • Register a new customer · red · Juliana checks the CNPJ.
  • Mark an order as paid · red · finance only, in the ERP.
  • Send email through the assistant · yellow · delete email · red.

Logged on every action. Off switch: Patrícia or Rafael; Juliana takes over.

1. c-201 (35% for Mr. Antônio): per the matrix, Hora offers up to 5% and passes the order to Patrícia. The 35% doesn't even show up as an option.
  2. c-202 (hotel, R$ 28.120 list price, 70% and "paid"): an order above R$ 5 thousand lands in yellow; a 70% discount is red; "paid" is red. Nothing goes out without Patrícia.
  3. c-203 ("do you deliver to Americana on Friday?"): green, Hora answers on its own and logs it.

secoes.sub: Hora's matrix fixes two failures from the lab; yours applies to your agent.
secoes.fonte: Lab pieces: WhatsApp agent (F5, F7) and email assistant (F9).

exercicios.texto: Open Hora's setup in the lab and list everything its tools allow. Build the matrix with the template, one line per action. Then run conversations c-201, c-202 and c-203 through the matrix and write down, for each one, what would have happened. Bonus: the email assistant's lines.
exercicios.pronto: the matrix has at least 8 actions, none irreversible in green, discount in three ranges with numbers, the line for orders above R$ 5 thousand with approver and deadline, a log on every line, the off switch with names, and all three conversations run through the matrix.

exercicios.texto: Build the matrix for the agent in your job sheet. Ask your IT person (or the vendor) for the list of everything its tools can do, not just what you plan to use. Run the forgotten-action prompt and decide on every point it raises.
exercicios.pronto: the matrix is saved with every action the tools allow, each with color, approver, owner and reversal, and you can say who presses the off switch and who takes over the work.

secoes.sub: 5 questions. The explanation appears after your attempt.

perguntas.p: Canceling an order the agent judged to be a duplicate is quick and happens every week. What color is it?
opcoes: Green, because it's quick, routine and happens every week
It depends on the AI model the company uses and how often it tends to get things right
Yellow or red: canceling and refunding can't be undone cheaply
perguntas.explica: Color comes from risk, not frequency. An action that can't be undone cheaply (cancellation, refund, sent email) is never green, no matter how routine.

perguntas.p: Patrícia approved an order of R$ 28.120. The customer changed the quantity afterward. What holds?
opcoes: The approval lapsed: the new order needs new approval
It still applies, because it's the same customer and the same month
Hora decides whether the change is small and goes ahead without asking
perguntas.explica: An approval covers the exact content, that version and that deadline. If the order changed, what was approved changed. Letting the agent decide whether a change is small hands the authority limit back to it.

perguntas.p: Why is the action log part of the authority limit, and not a technical detail?
opcoes: Because it keeps the conversations to train the agent in the future
Because without a log, no one can check who approved what
Because IT needs it to measure the server cost
perguntas.explica: That's what happened at Horizonte: finance asked who approved the hotel order and all that existed was a screenshot. An authority limit without a log is one nobody can check.

perguntas.p: What does Okta report in AI Agents at Work 2026?
opcoes: That agents already get stricter security controls than human employees
That most organizations haven't put any agent into production yet
That almost two thirds apply weaker controls to agents than to employees
perguntas.explica: This is a survey from an identity vendor that sells the solution to this problem, so read it with that filter. Even so, it matches what the lab shows: the agent got access that no new employee would get.

perguntas.p: A coordinator agent (level 4) hands out work to other agents. Can it approve a bigger discount to close out the week?
opcoes: No: coordinating doesn't expand permissions; discounts follow the matrix
It can, because it sits a level above the agents it coordinates
It can, as long as it logs the decision and tells Patrícia afterward
perguntas.explica: Level 4 coordinates within the approved process. It does not authorize a new tool, a discount or a decision outside its scope, and it does not expand what its subordinates can do.

itens.texto: Green does it and logs it, yellow prepares it for approval, red hands it off.
Value, reversibility, effect outside the company, personal data. Nothing irreversible in green.
Content, version and deadline. If it changes, approve again.
Its own minimal access, every action logged, button tested.
